Map Manly · zone sheet

A Zone A: Belgrave Street, Sydney Road, Rowe Street, Park Avenue

Meet at
West Esplanade, by the art gallery
Harbour-front shared path
Points
41: 24 crossings, 2 entrances, 10 flights of steps, 5 slopes
Loop
About 3.1 km there and back, plus 5.7 km of footpaths to note on the way
Time
About 3.2 hours for a pair, with rests
Terrain
Hilly, with steps. Best for walkers who are happy on hills. Skip any point you can’t reach.

How to use this sheet. Start at M, go in number order and come back to M. Tick what you see; write numbers in the gaps. Skip anything you can’t reach safely and write “skipped”. On the way, note dotted orange footpaths: surface, smoothness and narrowest width (StreetComplete asks these for you).

F Zone F: Darley Road, East Esplanade, Victoria Parade, South Steyne

Meet at
East Esplanade Park
Harbour side, by Manly Cove
Points
40: 20 crossings, 10 entrances, 4 flights of steps, 6 slopes
Loop
About 2.35 km there and back, plus 3.7 km of footpaths to note on the way
Time
About 3.1 hours for a pair, with rests
Terrain
Hilly, with steps. Best for walkers who are happy on hills. Skip any point you can’t reach.

How to use this sheet. Start at M, go in number order and come back to M. Tick what you see; write numbers in the gaps. Skip anything you can’t reach safely and write “skipped”. On the way, note dotted orange footpaths: surface, smoothness and narrowest width (StreetComplete asks these for you).
